notable_absence.finding: The page states 'As of Couchbase Server 7.1, the Search service doesn't offer auto-failover capability' - a caveat dated to a version six major releases behind the 8.0 docs it now ships in, with no updated statement anywhere on the page confirming whether this is still true in 8.0 or is simply unmaintained copy. This round's first-contact status for this page means there is no 7.2 twin to check whether the sentence was already stale then too.

cross_component_finding: This page directly answers the round framing's own question: the Zero Downtime Index Upgrades section explicitly names 'the index-alias feature' and 'a clone of the current index' as its mechanism - confirmed, via fts:clone-index (minted for fts-clone-index.md in this same batch) and search:index-aliases (the NEW-generation concept that fts-create-index-aliases.md, also in this batch, was found to duplicate). So the zero-downtime upgrade mechanism transitively depends on a search/-generation concept, not a purely old-generation one. Separately, this page's manual-failover caveat is the summary of the full step-by-step procedure fts-rebalance-failover.md (also in this batch) documents in detail - see fts:manual-failover-for-search.
cross_product_finding: No Capella/cloud twin exists - Capella's docs have no fts/ tree at all, and no cloud/ page under any name was found documenting Search HA/failover mechanics in this dispatch.
